answers.core: This directly improves the usability of the application. All users of the software will have to make a decision when creating a new project, which means its a feature that will be widely encountered.
answers.workaround: I believe this enhancement will be used frequently by new users especially. Experienced users may also find the direct access link useful if they chose to learn about a new renderer option. While the documentation page can be found manually, providing it directly within the application will improve the usability.

title: Add a documentation link to the renderer selection dialog when creating a new project
